I had a great experience at Kendall Animal Medical Center, starting with my phone call this morning. When I brought Koko in, we did not have to sit in the waiting room for a long time. Everyone listened to my concerns, and the vet tech and veterinarian were both amazing.

Koko is 11 pounds but very sassy, and they bonded with her right away. I felt good about the care she received and will definitely bring her back for preventative care.

Amazing! Came in with my dog as an emergency and was treated so good and quick and with a lot of love. My dog Belle was not nervous as she usually is bc the vibes and staff were perfect. So grateful how good my Belle was treated. Highly recommend :) THANK YOU!
Great Clinic, speedy service.
amazing care for my husky, wouldnt go anywhere else!

Excellent and very friendly veterinarians, I highly recommend them
Excellent doctors and very affordable prices! I highly recommend them.
They have taken amazing care of my Dax boy after his neutering experience. Nothing but love and care and you can tell they love their job!
Great doctors.   Great staff.  I highly recommend this place
My dog loves coming to this place, they are so friendly and caring! It’s the only vet I take my dog to
We had a great experience. We recommend this vet.
Super

Great job

Excellent!!
amazing everything
Love coming here with Doctor Schoolie. She’s amazing and my baby is happy.
Staff is very helpful and friendly and they saved Serena's life when she ate a chicken bone and have been great about her meds. Would and do recommend.
Professional, and kind, saw my dog for an emergency visit same day.
Great service. Friendly and thorough.

I can’t say enough great things about the care Sparky received. From the moment we walked in, everyone was kind, welcoming, and truly compassionate.

A special thank you to Dr. Scolly and the amazing technicians, Elio and Sophia, for the exceptional care they gave Sparky. They treated him with so much patience, kindness, and genuine love, and it was clear they truly care about the animals they see. Their professionalism, communication, and attention to detail made us feel confident that Sparky was in the best hands.

Thank you, Dr. Scolly, Elio, and Sophia, for going above and beyond. Your dedication and compassion mean more than words can express. I highly recommend this team to anyone looking for outstanding veterinary care. Sparky and our family are truly grateful!
Very kind and attentive staff!!
Amazing vet! Been taking my fur baby here since he was 6 months old and have already gone through a major surgery with them. Very professional and very patient with all of my questions.

Yestina was a great help, very lively and sweet and cares deeply about the animals she sees. Doctor Schooley is very wise and knows exactly what she's talking about, very lovely woman! BRING YOUR PETS HERE!!!
We took our cat Charlie here and there were super nice and super knowledgeable. Love the atmosphere and the love that they showed him.

I can’t thank the entire team enough for the amazing care they always give my dog, Toky. Every visit has been a great experience, and they always treat him with so much kindness, patience, and genuine compassion.

This time I brought him in because he injured his little leg, and once again they did everything they could to help him and make sure he was comfortable.

Thank you for always taking such great care of Toky. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a veterinary team that truly cares.
Great experience love them for my chow chows
Excellent service, very helpful and very good with my dog
Kendall Animal Medical Center is a great place for pets. Lucas, my doggie, has been receiving medical here for more than a year and the staff is always friendly and caring.
I’ve been taking both my dog and cat here since i adopted them. I love this vet! They are very transparent and welcoming. The receptionist is always so nice as well. Recommend!!!
All the staff are super professional.
The girls at the office were so sweet and professional.

First of all I wanted to say that my cat Rex  has the best Vet Dr. Javid. He is so sweet with him. He provided the best care possible to Rex at a reasonable price. Natalie his assistant was wonderful with Rex too, everyone from the front desk person to all the technicians in clinic today were amazing. The moment I walked in I was assigned to a room and didn’t have to wait at all. Rex was treated like a King. I recommend this clinic to everyone in need of a wonderful vet.

I have gone to this vet before and have had a very good experience with caring vets but recently I had brought him back lethargic, not eating, and it seemed his eyes were yellowing. I was charged for an eye X-ray and ointments. When my partner and I showed our frustrations because something just wasn’t adding up we were told multiple times “he’s a frenchie” and “We signed up for this”. Two days later he’s vomiting, still not eating, and completely jaundice so I bring him back and turns out he had leptospirosis. My sweet boy had passed four days later after being is the ICU.
With the correct diagnoses and care there would've been a much higher chance of survival. My partner and I are very upset over this loss and regret not using our gut instincts over his sickness.

PLEASE READ IF YOU CARE ABOUT YOUR ANIMAL
I have to write this review from a different account due to a legal battle I am currently in with this establishment. They have multiple vets working here that are misdiagnosing animals. Cant say much but they did it to my sweet baby boy and they aren't facing any backlash for the violent and horrific acts they've done. KAMC, if you happen to read this review, dont bother responding.
Absolutely love Dr. Markova. She took her time to diagnose and provide a reasonable treatment plan.
awesome service.
Highly recommended, always take care of my puppy

They misdiagnosed my dog which resulted in the death of my dog a few days later. Don’t bring your dog here unless you’d like to be rushed and not taken serious. Half of their staff is great (Natalie and Benjamin), but the other doctor and the rest of the staff who works there is incompetent. I brought my dog in who was clearly yellow with jaundice, and I voiced my concerns to the vet. I was not even sat in a medical room, I was met in the lobby to quickly diagnose the dog 1 and a half hours AFTER my scheduled appointment. I was sent home with some meds being told this was an ear infection. 3 days later we brought the dog to the ER and he was diagnosed with Leptospirosis and died shortly after. They told us if we had caught this sooner (which we tried to with this Vet) he probably could have made it through this alive. Long story short I spent over $7,000 at the hospital and after the dog passed away I emailed Chris who owns this vet, he told me he’d get back to me in 24hrs. It’s been 3 weeks, I’ve emailed him 3 times and officially is not responding so here I am taking things into my own hands.
Very good attention with my dog and they were very transparent about everything.
They were great. I got the treatment my cat needed.
Great service. Very knowledgeable and took me I. With same day appointment
Amazing

The service and care and Kendall Animal Medical Center is second to none. The love they have for my pet is felt every time I come.
Horrible customer service. I feel bad for the pets that will be brought here.
Great experience from the moment I walked in and treated my dog great every time!
Dr. Benjamin's service was terrible, truly unprofessional. I do not recommend this place.
The staff was very professional and attentive. Very pleased with my experience.
Best front desk and doctors. Professional and fast.

My Pomeranian puppies had their first vet visit here, and the service was excellent!
We'll continue their checkups here until they're ready for their new homes.
I have a 3 month old kitten and I was worried that she wasn’t feeling good so I called here and they squeezed me in and got her seen
Dr. Ben Javid is the best vet we’ve ever found. We’ve followed him from his last office and are so grateful he’s still in Miami. He’s saved our dog more than once. Thanks Doctor Ben!

Great staff, very friendly and very helpful with my dog.

Love this place

Thank you

Excellent professional service.Dr Javid was excellent and took time to explain the vaccines and check ups performed and provided great recommendations for how to care for our lab. Our lab has been treated here since he was pup and so I can whole heartedly  recommend Kendall Animal Medical Center.
Very nice staff. Clean and comfortable facilities.

Wow I had the best experience! It was my first time here and Scarlett at the front made everything so easy! She explained everything clearly and was so patient. (I was a little frantic about my pet) Without a doubt I would come back!
My dog is usually very anxious and they took amazing care of her. Never felt so supported at the vet!
Great Service!
Always caring and client centered.
The best!! They treat everyone so friendly
Amazing service, doctor and staff are very professional and knowledgeable

With pain in my soul, I write this review in hopes it will help someone. I brought my golden retriever here immediately after he refused to eat. His gums were pale, he was lethargic, and he was panting excessively. I confused this place with an ER pet hospital. They claim they’re “critical care”. This cannot be true. I waited over 6 hours & $1,800+ dollars later to tell me he had severe pneumonia infection, they injected him with antibiotics gave me some antibiotics, anti nausea medication and meds to increase his appetite since he was not eating and the medications were in pill form.

By the time I got him back, he looked worse than he was 6 hours earlier when I brought him in. I got there at 5pm and left past 11pm. He died at 3am that night. They blamed the delay in care on short staffing. They were nice, but BEWARE. You have been warned.

Did writing this review make me feel better? No, I’m devastated. He was my 8 yr old baby boy. Would he still be alive if I’d gone somewhere else? I guess we’ll never know.
Always love this vet. Great hours and great staff
Amazing vets helping me out with Rex with his respiratory infection, highly recommend

I’m very grateful for the care and compassion the team showed my cats Ella and Damon. They were patient, attentive, and took the time to answer my questions and make me feel comfortable during a stressful time. You can tell they truly care about animals and their families. Thank you for treating my babies with kindness and professionalism.
Natalie and the Doctor were very nice and caring. Our kittens were seen very fast.
Very good emergency room
Super nice and friendly place that made me feel welcomed. Very fast service of my nail trim for my puppy.
Excellent service! We always bring our pets here!! Fully recommend!
Very good service! Natalie explained everything in detail for my pets health and allergy concerns

Hands down the best vet experience. The facility is spotless, the staff is incredibly welcoming, and the doctors are thorough and genuinely care about the animals. They don't rush you and truly prioritize your pet's well-being.
Excellent service, they treated me very well and we left happy
Dr. David and the office staff were so compassionate and helpful. Highly recommend this vet!
Great service, kind people!
Thank you all for being so caring and helping us be first time parents to 4 kittens from a stray cat who chose us. Special thank you to Natalie   You are the best.

Kendall Medical Center was referred to me by a family member who’s been bringing her pets her for several years, after finding a little kitty outside our house we decided to keep it and after bringing him to this facility we quickly realized they were very kind, knowledgeable and loving towards our little Kitty. The entire staff is great and Doctor Javid is a fantastic doctor to have taking care of your pets! Highly recommended because they’ve shown me they truly care about animals and their well being!
Brought Gracie Lou Paolella in for annual shots and check up. Got in and out fast. Thank you Natalie the vet tec!
The Doctor was great. She came out and gave us her recommendations. She was very knowledgeable and Charlie loved her.
The staff were amazing and they took such good care of my cat Pepper. I highly recommend taking your pets here!
Recently moved to this area and this is the only place we bring our dogs! Love this place and the staff are really friendly.

I am so glad I found this place I was feeling hopeless with my kitty who is unfortunately not going to last but here they gave me some comfort in giving her some medicine in hope to help the little time she has. THANK YOU FROM THE BOTTOM OF MY HEART
Great service. Professional staff. Highly recommend
I had an amazing experience. The vet tech Natali was very kind and helpful with my cat and the dr was very professional and nice too. I highly recommend them!

Provided emergency services for my bulldog Tank. Went above and beyond their duty to act and saved his life. Doctors & nursing staff provided excellent service and are extremely competent in their craft. You can clearly see that Veterinarian Ben & his staff have a passion for animals. 10/10 recommend!
Always coming here to have Dr. Schooley check on my kitty! I love her and the hospitality the team gives us.

Excellent service and very professional. They treated my pet with great care and patience, explained everything clearly, and genuinely cared about his well-being. The place was clean and organized, and the staff was very friendly. I'm very grateful for their treatment and dedication. I highly recommend this clinic.
Great place, great care

The staff is incredibly friendly, everyone is super nice. I’ve been bringing my dog here since he was a puppy. Even during emergencies, they always find a way to fit you in and take great care of him.
amazing vet , took care of my cat super fast and solved his issues !

I came in as a walk-in, super worried because my husky dog was having stomach issues. Dr. Schooley and the whole team was super helpful, empathetic and were able to get my dog Luna the attention and help she needed! I highly recommend this place (:

We've been coming for years,
and always fantastic service
Love this place! Great service and care for my dog.

Have been coming here for years and always a great experience. Highly recommended. Staff and vets are great!

We end up waiting longer often to get seen.

The care my pets have received has been great and everyone’s been very honest and kind.

I called in for a last minute appointment on a Sunday for a kitten I found Saturday night and they were able to fit us in. The front desk was amazing and the doctor explained everything and took his time. The tech came in after and went over all my instructions again. Highly recommended and they didn’t break the bank

Kendall Animal Medical Center is Amazing!

I cannot say enough great things about Kendall Animal Medical Center. From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted with warmth and professionalism. The staff is incredibly caring, knowledgeable, and attentive—not just to the pets, but to the owners as well. They take the time to explain every detail, ensuring you feel comfortable and informed about your pet’s care.

The veterinarians are exceptional. They go above and beyond to provide the best treatment possible, showing genuine compassion for every animal that comes through their doors. Whether it’s a routine checkup or a more serious health concern, I always feel confident that my pet is in the best hands.

The facility itself is spotless, well-organized, and welcoming. It’s clear they take pride in maintaining a clean and comfortable environment for pets and their owners.

Kendall Animal Medical Center truly stands out for their dedication to excellence and their love for animals. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for top-tier care for their furry family members!!

I just love this clinic, the nurse, the doctor… OMG .. just awesome; even the lady at the front desk… I recommend this clinic 💯 …
The staff is amazing and very helpful they take great care of my dog great service

Sophia was amazing! She went above and beyond to help both me and my cat, and made the whole experience feel comfortable and reassuring. I’m so grateful for her care and kindness will definitely be coming back.

Kendall Animal Clinic has been absolutely wonderful with my dog, Belle. From the moment we walk in, the staff is kind, patient, and genuinely caring. The veterinarians take the time to explain everything clearly, answer all my questions, and make sure Belle is comfortable and well cared for.

You can truly tell they love animals and treat each pet as if it were their own. Belle always receives attentive, gentle care, and I leave every visit feeling confident and reassured that she’s in the best hands.

I’m so grateful to have found a clinic that combines professionalism, compassion, and excellent veterinary care. I highly recommend Kendall Animal Clinic to anyone looking for exceptional care for their pets.
Amazing experience! So reassuring, comforting and knowledgeable- Dr Kushner was phenomenal and so were the nurses and front desk! Thank you!

West Kendall Animal Hospital is truly the best veterinary office I’ve been to. The staff are so good with my cats and extremely knowledgeable. It’s hard to find a vet I can trust with my cats but they truly make them feel comfortable and go the extra mile to make sure they are comfortable. Dr. Borroto is the best and I’m so happy with how she has treated my boys ❤️ I would recommend this vet to any cat owners!
Thank you all at Kendall Animal Medical Center for taking care of my babies, Magic and Moana! Appreciate your expertise and care!
Very nice staff, and i loved my experience. And im glad they were able to give us an appointment the same day thankfully.

Please DO NOT trust this place. Rude and disrespectful employees. They shouldn't be providing services without being qualified. Today, December 2nd, they denied me a medical record document, claiming that the consultation and service never took place. Thankfully, my pet's insurance had a copy of the document and provided it to me.
The vets here are caring and wonderful. I have 3 cats and they take great care of all of them
I had a great service here with my dog yesterday and they were so attentive! I definitely recommend this vet. They were so patient with me

I can't express how wonderful and magical this clinic turned out to be for me and my family. I took my dog, Felipe, in for an emergency, and they received him quickly and gave him special attention.

The doctor was direct and clear with me, giving me the diagnosis I didn't want to hear: Felipe had advanced cancer. They were transparent with all the information, showed me kindness, dried my tears, gave me water, and helped me understand the process of letting go of my pet. When everything was ready for euthanasia, the doctor was in the room the whole time, with my son, Felipe, and me. When Felipe was at rest, they showed me even more understanding and kindness and gave me enough time to cope with his passing.
A week later, they called to give me Felipe's ashes in a beautiful box, with a card signed by the clinic staff offering their condolences. And the most beautiful thing was that I was able to have Felipe's handprints engraved both on wood and on paper to frame. Most importantly, they were completely humane, understanding, and treated Felipe with love and dignity as they said their final goodbyes.

I made an appointment at 10am and when I got to the place they were closed and no one was at the office. I waited outside for 15 minutes and three other families came because they had appointments and still no one was there to open the office. They also never answer the phone. Very unprofessional.

Expensive! They took the dog, examined her themselves, and didn't let me in, which I found very strange. It didn't inspire confidence, and the prices are high compared to other places, which is what I was looking for.

Damnn Joke!! Yes people are a joke. Attempt to charge me a $3,600 bill!
Stating "Your dog has Pervo". The Jamaican lady (the nurse) face expression was saying "thats not true,"but again, she has to back up the Vet because its her job. They made me stand outside with ky down for a total of 1hr and 25 mins! Did a test and shown me a results thats couldve been from another dog. I called for a refill, due to th3 medication was given in pills. I told them my dog doesn't do good with pills and 3 were wasted. Not they want me to bring him in for a recheck up and spend another $200 dollar???  Place is a JOKE!!! MONEY HUNGRY JOKE

They asked me for a survey a review here it is

Great service and reasonable prices!
I love their staff, Izzy was very kind and explained everything to care for my dog whisky
Thank you!

They take amazing care of our animals. 💕💕💕
I love this vet! We’ve had 2 different vets at this office over a few years and you can tell they’re both animal lovers and genuinely care about the wellbeing of our cats and dog.
They actually saved the life of one of our cats, Calvin.
Also, they’re easy to schedule with and reception people are super nice too. 😻

New Management and or ownership has destroyed this office.  If I can give it negative one stars I would. They overcharge by enormous amounts. An allergy shot I used to get there at $70, they were trying to charge me $185 . I called a separate Vet and asked for a quote and they said it was $90. Go figure I guess they’re overcharging because their office is completely empty so they’re trying to make up for their rent money.
Excellent

My family and I took our beloved dog Abby for a second opinion to Kendall Animal Medical Center. We were seen by vet tech Chris who spoke with us after reviewing Abby’s medical records. He introduced us to Dr. Faria who after reviewing the medical records she immediately suggested that we do an endoscopy to see what Abby had in her stomach. The next day the endoscopy was done at Kendall Point animal hospital,which is also a great facility. A couple of days later we spoke with Dr Faria who suggested we immediately perform surgery to remove a tumor from her stomach. Unfortunately the tumor had in crouched on her esophagus and the surgeon said he could not remove the tumor. At this point we had to make the hardest decision of our lives. Dr Faria aloud my family and I to be with Abby until it was time to say goodbye. Dr Faria and her staff were amazing. Dr Faria had Abby lying in the kennel on top of a blanket and covered with a second blanket just like she loved to do at home. Dr Faria also returned a large portion of the money we had already paid for the surgery. The level of care Abby received was above and beyond I have ever experienced with a veterinary hospital. I definitely recommend Dr Faria her staff and her facility for all your veterinary needs. Once again thank you Dr Faria and your staff for all your support during this difficult time.
Very professional and knowledgable staff. Lots of parking options

Very kind and sweet woman at the front desk that did our intake over the phone. We had an emergency with our elderly dog right before closing and they gave us swift attention, and when the doctor realized the problem was more serious, she immediately referred us to an ER close by and even pointed out which one would be the most cost efficient. It was a sad and anxious visit, but the staff has great interpersonal skills and an obvious love for the pets we bring to them. I couldn’t recommend them more.

I can’t say enough wonderful things about this clinic. Every time something happens with my fur babies, Destini and Dr. Faria are right there to comfort me and reassure me that my pups will be okay. They truly care, not just about my dogs, but about me as a pet parent. From the warm welcome when I walk in to the gentle care they give until the moment we leave, I always know my dogs are in loving, capable hands. I live in Weston, but I gladly drive all the way to Kendall because there’s no one I trust more than Destini and Dr. Faria to care for my babies. They’re family to us.

It’s not easy finding a place where we feel truly comfortable bringing our pets when they’re unwell. We’ve been coming to this Animal Medical Center for years, and once again, the team exceeded our expectations.

This week alone, we had to bring our dog in twice (Wednesday and Saturday) due to something he ate. Each time, he was seen right away, and we were clearly informed about his condition, the necessary treatment, and how to care for him at home.

Yesterday, Chris went above and beyond to make us feel at ease with our dog’s Dx. He took the time to explain everything thoroughly and even showed me the X-rays, which I really appreciated.

Thank you for always providing such compassionate and professional care.

My cat Conan had reached the point of no return. It was suspected but unknown to me at the time. I knew he was very ill, but I couldn’t seem to get a diagnosis . . . until Dr. Faria came along   In one visit she took an X-ray, showed me the multiple issues Conan had from which she, in total honesty, told me he would very likely never recover, and that he was suffering. I needed her honesty to be able to let him go. The staff are wonderful, compassionate, and kind also. I am so grateful and would highly recommend Kendall Animal Center for the needs of your pets.
We're so happy we found this vet. She's awesome and so was the staff

We have gone to this vet for my mother’s dogs. One of her dogs passed away and they were not sensitive to the situation. It was very cold and when I heard the doctor on the phone with the receptionist he was rude cursing about the dog. Very disappointed
Wonderful experience the staff and management where incredible and made my girl feel safe (photos after she has recovered)

Dr. Faria and her team truly saved my cats life. She is so kind and truly loves what she does! I’m so, so grateful for all the care and help we received. I will recommend this vet to everyone, always — and forever will. Thank you from the bottom of my heart!

I am forever grateful to the incredible team at this veterinary clinic. They didn’t just care for my pet they saved her life. My sweet Luna wouldn’t be here today if it weren’t for their quick action, compassion, and dedication.

Dr. Faria is an absolute superstar. She is so knowledgeable, gentle, and truly cares from the heart. Throughout the entire process, she was patient with me, understanding of my emotions, and made sure I never felt alone. The entire staff is just as amazing kind, attentive, and full of love for every animal that walks through their doors.

Thank you from the bottom of my heart for giving Luna a second chance. I will always remember what you’ve done for us.

I had to euthanize my cat in this place, being a very sensitive issue because it was my pet and my children's for more than 10 years, we paid for the private cremation service to have the ashes of our cat and not a portion of different pets as is the regular service, they told us that in 1 week we would have the remains in an urn with the name and fingerprint of my cat, today after 3 weeks I do not receive any call from them, I called 4 different times during the last 3 weeks and they do not give me a solution telling me to call the cremation company directly, which I refused because I did not make the contract with them but with the veterinarian, today I have no guarantee that this veterinary company has an adequate process, since as a client I did not receive correct treatment and after this I doubt that the treatment my pet received before euthanasia was correct or that they have a correct and humane procedure, I have spent more than 3000 dollars in this veterinarian for the final treatment and euthanasia of my pet, today I completely doubt their Professionalism and procedures. I will ask the Miami-Dade County District for a full audit of this veterinary clinic and its procedures, and I reserve the right to take legal action.

Love the doctor and the staff! Everyone is always so nice and they're wonderful with my Roxy. Joy and Yumi are definitely an asset to this office as well. I would recommend this vet office, 100%!
